# testing_x_pagination_urls (Data Source)

XPaginationUrls DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "testing_x_pagination_urls" "my_xpaginationurls" {
  string_request = "...my_string_request..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `string_request` (String) Configurable string for request, to ensure other configurable
attributes are not affected by pagination having input attributes
removed.

### Read-Only

- `results` (List of String)
